entries.name: 南岛哲学
entries.recognitionCue: Tropical archipelago, distant volcano, sunset transitioning into a starry blue night, turquoise sea, complete outrigger/double-hulled sailboats and traditional shore villages; foreground people discussing a navigation aid/circular star-direction chart, carved wooden figures, shells and baskets. Preserve cultural clothing, natural individuality and every purposeful gesture; paint skin finely rather than shiny. Keep sea-navigation and communal knowledge at center, no Europeanized dress or ships.

entries.name: 太平洋原住民哲学
entries.recognitionCue: Island coast, palm grove, thatched ancestral building, Moai-like and carved wooden forms, whole canoe/sailboat group, jumping whale, turtle and coral water. Retain the oral-teaching group examining its chart in lower-left, their faces/poses/ornaments, and characteristic local boats. Fine oil-painted color planes for faces, cloth, sea and clouds without losing turquoise-gold palette, no photographic gloss or unrelated giant deity.

entries.name: 兵家
entries.recognitionCue: Retain the six distinct strategists and every meaningful gesture around the broad terrain/sand-table model with its tiny units, mountains and routes. Keep the rolls of bamboo/text, small rulers/tools, restrained pavilion columns and lantern, broad river valley and distant mountain terrain corresponding to the model. Scene is thoughtful strategic inquiry, not fighting or a leader portrait. Subtle ink-wash mountain gradients, fine dry-brush vegetation and refined oil-painted individual faces/cloth; original dark restrained palette, no orange blanket.

entries.name: 法家
entries.recognitionCue: Retain the orderly administration scene with distinct writers and clerks in period dark robes, existing bamboo law/document strips, writing brushes, ink pots, central map table and whole axial city beyond the pavilion. Keep numerous figures at original scale with distinct activities; no foreground leader hero. Let law, recordkeeping and civic organization read through instruments and documents. Quiet ink-like architectural contours and distant mountains, fine painterly facial planes and wood/cloth, preserve original muted black/ochre palette.
